# order-configuration-ui-mockup-step0-2.png

**Type:** UI wireframe/mockup.
**Source context:** `# Description` section, illustrating Step0-Step2 of
the order capture flow.

Three linked panels:

1. **Step0** — the "Our B2C Catalogue" eligibility-result screen (same
   shape as TMFS002's catalogue screen) with "Fiber Offering - Silver"
   selected.
2. **Step1** — "Your Order - New Fiber Contract Silver": the included
   Fiber Access Standard line (Basic Speed selected, 12,00€/month,
   Installation Fees 33,00€) and Fix Communication Service
   (14,40€/month), plus Box options (Box 1 / Apple Green / Standard
   Storage selected, 4,80€/month) and TV channels options (Basic
   selected, 6,00€/month), with a "Validate Configuration" action.
3. **Step2** — the same order screen after re-configuring the Box
   options (Box 1 / Strawberry Red / Maxi Storage now selected,
   6,00€/month) with a "Validate Configuration" action highlighted.
